Politics · India

China says leaders reached consensus on partnership

Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi stated that Chinese President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi reached a "most important consensus" during a meeting on the sidelines of the BRICS summit. Wang Yi, quoting Xi, said that China and India should be partners and that under the leaders' guidance, relations have gradually emerged from a low point, progressing from a 'restart' to a 'renewed height.' The meeting occurred during Xi's visit to New Delhi on September 12-13.
